Start with your own code

Start from scratch or use your existing code. Open a terminal in your project folder, or an empty folder for a new app.

  1. Initialize your app

    azd init

    When prompted, choose:

    • Scan current directory

      Prepare your existing app for Azure.

    • Set up with GitHub Copilot

      Get AI help building a new app or preparing existing code.

  2. Provision and deploy

    azd up

    Review the generated files, then create the Azure resources and deploy your app.
